_: iPhone wording for Learn guides (BUILD-PLAN §5.6). Each rule replaces text inside the guide with that id; a rule that no longer matches fails the build, so a changed guide is reviewed again. Gate hits in Learn are fixed here, never exempted. Owner to approve the wording.

learn-how-to-remove-malware.find: data-keywords="remove malware antivirus clean infected disconnect safe mode steps"
learn-how-to-remove-malware.replace: data-keywords="remove malware clean infected disconnect update reset steps"
Step by step: disconnect, update, remove, recover.

learn-how-to-remove-malware.find: Step 2: Boot into Safe Mode if your device supports it — this loads only essential system processes, which can prevent some malware from actively running and hiding itself.
learn-how-to-remove-malware.replace: Step 2: On an iPhone, update iOS (Settings > General > Software Update), delete apps you don't recognise, and remove unknown configuration or VPN profiles (Settings > General > VPN & Device Management).

learn-how-to-remove-malware.find: Step 3: Run a full scan using trusted, reputable antivirus or anti-malware software.
learn-how-to-remove-malware.replace: Step 3: On a computer, use the security tools built into its operating system.

learn-how-to-remove-malware.find: Step 4: Remove or quarantine everything the scan flags as suspicious.
learn-how-to-remove-malware.replace: Step 4: If problems continue, back up what you need and reset the device, or contact the maker's support (for an iPhone, Apple Support).

learn-vpns-explained.find: An encrypted tunnel that protects your internet traffic.
learn-vpns-explained.replace: An encrypted tunnel for your internet traffic.

learn-vpns-explained.find: It's also not a replacement for antivirus software, since it doesn't scan for or remove malware.
learn-vpns-explained.replace: It also does not check for or remove harmful software.
